problems.problem: The results section states an effective length constant of 2.3 subunits in the counter-clockwise direction and 0.7 subunits in the clockwise direction, but the abstract states 3.2 subunits counter-clockwise against 0.7 subunits clockwise.
The results section states that truncating the C-terminal helix reduces the counter-clockwise length constant to 1.8 subunits, but the abstract and conclusion do not mention this change.
The conclusion states an effective length constant of 2.3 subunits in one direction against 0.7 in the other, but the abstract states 3.2 subunits counter-clockwise against 0.7 subunits clockwise.
